blocks.text: This Name occurs in the Noble Qur'aan more than 150 times. Allaah said,
He creates what He wills. And it is He Who is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful (i.e. Able to do all things).
and Allah is Sufficient as All-Knower.

This means the One Whose knowledge encompasses the apparent and the hidden; the secret and the open; knowledge of the upper and lower; the past, present and future. Not one thing is hidden from Him. He knew what was, what will be and what was not; and if it were, how it would be. His knowledge encompasses everything and He keeps count of all things (knows the exact number of everything).
Faith in this magnificent Name has a blessed effect upon the servant. It is in fact the biggest deterrent and greatest admonition.

Shaykh Muhammad al-Ameen ash-Shinqeetee said, "The scholars have agreed that it is the biggest admonition and the greatest deterrent that was revealed from the heavens to the earth... you do not turn a single page of the Noble mushaf without finding this great admonition and great deterrent.
And He is the All-Knower of everything.
And Allah is Well-Acquainted with what you do.
And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

And with Him are the keys of the Ghaib (all that is hidden), none knows them but He. And He knows whatever there is in (or on) the earth and in the sea; not a leaf falls, but he knows it. There is not a grain in the darkness of the earth nor anything fresh or dry, but is written in a Clear Record.
And indeed We have created man, and We know what his ownself whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (by Our Knowledge).
And know that Allah knows what is in your minds, so fear Him.

Whatever you (O Muhammad) may be doing, and whatever portion you may be reciting from the Quran, - and whatever deed you (mankind) may be doing (good or evil), We are Witness thereof, when you are doing it.
So all of us we need to take heed of this great deterrent and mighty admonition and not forget it so as not to destroy ourselves."

keyPoints: The Name Al-'Aleem occurs in the Noble Qur'aan more than 150 times.
It means the One Whose knowledge encompasses the apparent and the hidden, the secret and the open, the upper and lower, and the past, present and future.
He knew what was, what will be, and what was not and, if it were, how it would be; He keeps count of all things.
Faith in this Name is the biggest deterrent and greatest admonition for the servant.
Ash-Shinqeetee said the scholars agreed it is the biggest admonition revealed from the heavens, and no page of the mushaf is without it.

evidence.text: He creates what He wills. And it is He Who is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.
And with Him are the keys of the Ghaib (all that is hidden), none knows them but He... not a leaf falls, but he knows it.

recall.a: The One Whose knowledge encompasses the apparent and the hidden, the secret and the open, the upper and lower, the past, present and future; not one thing is hidden from Him.

recall.q: How many times does Al-'Aleem occur in the Qur'aan according to the book?
What did Shaykh ash-Shinqeetee say the scholars agreed upon regarding Allaah's knowledge?
recall.a: That it is the biggest admonition and the greatest deterrent revealed from the heavens to the earth; you do not turn a page of the mushaf without finding it.

recall.q: Which aayah mentions that not a leaf falls but He knows it?
Does Allaah's knowledge include what did not happen?
recall.a: Yes, He knew what was, what will be and what was not; and if it were, how it would be.
